7)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las:ka la piṅka'i sgra tshig mkha' 'gro'i zhal chems yang byang gab thig snying po bzhugs so:8)sa ma ya:dus re zhig gi tshe ra

tei:div.tei:p: 7) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: ka la piṅka'i sgra tshig mkha' 'gro'i zhal chems yang byang gab thig snying po bzhugs so: 8) sa ma ya: dus re zhig gi tshe rang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral red snyam pa zhig tu gnas skabs ka la piṅka'i sgra tshig 'di gdams so: a a āḥpheṃ: he sa ya na sa ma ya: he sa ya na tsit+tar 'chang: he sa ya na gu h+ya rgya: nga 'og min gnas kyi mkha' 'gro ma: 'khor 'das gnyis la dbang yang sgyur: gdod ma'i sangs rgyas nga la rag: srid gsum dbang ba'i dpa' mo che: legs nyes thams cad nga la rag: nga ni kun tu bzang mo'i 'phrul: 'khor 'das gsal ba'i me long yod: khyod dang nga gnyis sngon rol nas: skye ba du mar dbyer 9) med 'grogs: legs nyes thams cad nga yis bstan: dus dang dus su brda tshig ngoms: rang skal chos kyi them byang 'di: dgongs pa'i klong du rgya yis thob: (Dakini secret letter here) skal ldan don du yi ger bkod: he sa ya na ya snying la sbos: rang skal chos kyi gter kha ni: mi 'gyangs myur du 'byin pa gnad: g.yu yi rdza la gter kha lnga: gsang grogs sa ma ra yi ming: 'phrad nas rten 'brel ma 'dzol na: bstan 'gro'i bde skyid dpal du 'bar: mtha' dmag lnga bcu'i bar du bzlog: sbas gnas rdo rje pad+ma rdzong: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa'i gter kha yod: 10) sbrul gyi lo la 'byin par nges: gsang grogs dharma wāk+ka'i ming: chos bdag pradz+nya bud+dha dang: kirti sa man+ta yis brgyan: mkha' 'gro'i 'du gnas pad+ma rdzong: sbas gnas de la mtsho gter gcig: nor 'dzin lha mo'i sgrub skor yod: gsang grogs dharma'i ming dang 'phrad: chos 'dzin (Dakini secret letter here) ming mtha' 'dzin: a shwa'i smon 'grub mchod rten la: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi yang rdzong yod: gsang khrid skor rnams gter du bcol: 'brug gi lo la rang rdol 'byung: chos 'dzin o ḍī'i ming mtha' brgyan: gangs gnyis pa'i nub sgo dbang gi gnas:

mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i sgrub pa yod: gsang grogs mañdzu'i ming dang 'phrad: chos 'dzin (Dakini secret letter here) ming gis brgyan: de sogs sa gter lnga po la: dbang dang bskyed rdzogs cha tshang yod: gab 'khrugs man ngag lag len tshang: thabs dang shes rab ma 'dzol bar: mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin khyod bsgrub na: 'gro don gdul bya rab la dbang: smon log dam sris rkyen bskul nas: thabs dang ldan par dka' ba na: mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin khyod bsgrub na: 'gro don gdul bya rang la dbang: smon log dam sris rkyen bskul nas: thabs dang ldan par dka' ba na:

ḍā kis bka' chad khyod la 'bebs: chos skyong 11) srung mas 'khu ldog mang: mi 'dod sna tshogs rlung ltar 'tshubs: bdud sprul smon lam leg pa bdun du yod: rig pas dpyod la thabs kyis spang bar bya: de dag rab kyi las 'brel ma ldan na: dgongs pa'i klong nas rtsal snang brda ris btab: gab thig gsang mdzod snyan brgyud phran bu re: gsang grogs chos bdag rnams la rag las pas: thabs dang ldan na bskyed rdzaugs zab mo'i chos: mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud sna tshogs gab pa gsal: bdud sprul pradz+nyā'i ming dang dharma'i ming: shrī'i ming dang rā dza gu h+ya'i ming: smon log tā re rat+na pā shaṃ ming: rang dang mnyam du mi ring rang gnas yod: ya ga sgro skur mi 'dod sna 'dren byed: bla slob dam tshig gser thag g.ya' yis gos: mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pas zug ngu'i nad kyis thebs: bgrod byed mkha' 'gro nyams pa'i grib kyis gab: brgyud 'dzin yul du mi gnas gzhan du bgrod: de rnams rig pas dpyod la thad ka ru: brtul zhugs spyod pas gang byung lam du longs: sra mkhregs rdo rje'i go cha'i dpa' gding bskyed: gser dang ra gan ma nor rtog dpyod gyis: mkha' 'gro'i pho 12) nya rten 'brel kho nar thug: le lo'i dbang gis zab chos khyad ma gsod: gter gyi srung mar brngan mchod bstod bskul 'bungs: grogs dang chos 'dzin zog po ma nor ba: chos dang zob rdzun tsha gter log rig pas dpyod: zog po khag dkar snying nag sprel gtam che: bzang por brdzus nas bslu bar the tshom med: khyod ni zab chos dbang yang gzhan dbang shor: mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin ma bsgrubs ngal ba'i rgyu: brda 'chol 'gro don 'byung dka' tshe gegs che: sel byed gsang grogs dharmā ma ti'i ming: lha yi spyan 'dra sme bas mgul na brgyan: de yis re zhig gegs sel tshe tshad ni: nges med mkha' 'gro rang la rag las yod: rten dang 'brel 'byung gnad dang ldan gyur na:

tshe lo drug cu bar du skyob par nges: sa ma ya: g.yu yi rdza la gter kha lnga: gu ru'i sku tshab mtho gang ba: 'dzam bu'i chu gser grub pa yod: sku rgyab shog ser tshon gang tsam: sku rgyud shel gyi sgrub thabs yod: mtsho rgyal dbu ljon lan tshar gsum: bam ro'i thugs dam glegs bam yod: bram ze'i sku sha dum bu yod: 13) gsang grogs dpa' bo stag gis brgyan: gsang mgul sme bas rab tu mdzes: de dang 'phrad nas rim gyis spel: chos bdag dharma kīrti sogs: smin grol la 'god don gnyis 'grub: sbas gnas rdo rje pad+ma rdzong: mkha' 'gro'i thugs sgrub chos skor ni: g.yu yi sgrom bur ru tra yi: snying shun shog ser brda rgod yod: mtsho rgyal sku tshab mtho gang dang: g.yu sgra'i tshe ril 'ja' zug yod: gsang grogs dharma badz+ra dang: chos 'dzin pradz+nyā rasmi sogs: dus la babs tshe gtad rgya khrol: pad+ma rdzong gi gter kha ni: rdo sgrom chu 'dzin nag po'i gzugs: nor 'dzin lha mo'i sgrub skor ni: las tshogs cha tshang zin bris yod: pad+ma dbang gi sgrub thabs dang: 'khor 'das dbang sdud gdams skor rnams: rta yi lo la dus ni sbrul: gsang grogs mchog de bi ma dang: dharma dus su 'phrad nas 'byin: chos 'dzin bha dra dharma dang: kīrti kā ra'i dpal du 'phrad: smon grub mchod sdo mkha' 'gro'i gnas: gsang gter mkha' 'gro'i bla rdo dang: lha 'dre steng gi srog shing dang/ tshe ring mched lnga'i rten phur yod: pad+ma dbang gis sbas rdzong du: mkha' 'gro gsang 14) ba'i sgrub skor ni: rdo rje'i rgya dang pad+ma'i rgya: khams gsum dbang sdud las tshogs yod: gsang grogs bi ma rasmi'i ming: bi ma g.yu sgra nam snying sprul: sbrul lo shes bya'i blo gros rgyas: gter la dbang zhing spyod pa zhib: mi ring rang gnas lho nas 'byung: der 'phrad chos 'di'i gtad rgya khrol: chos 'dzin puṇ+ye shī la dngaḥ ak+ṣa rat+na bha dra'i ming:

badz+ra su kha sā ra dzaḥ shrī bi ma la sogs 'phrad: lcags ri 'od 'bar gsang ba'i gter: lug lor dus ni lto 'gros 'dzin: shel sgrom 'phags ma'i sgrub skor dang: dbang chen dmar po lha gsum yod: gsang grogs sa mān+ta dang ni: mañdzu'i ming 'phrad 'byin par nges: chos 'dzin dharma o ḍi sogs: rim gyis 'byung nas bstan 'gror smin: 'gro don shar dang lho na yod: brda byang ji bzhin ma nor bar: dus dang rten 'brel gnad la gzab: mkha' 'gros mngags pa'i pho nya la: log lta skur 'debs sna tshogs byed: mi 'dod bzhin du bstan 'gror smin: chos bdag mchog gi 15)bu lnga dang: brag ri 'dzin pa bcu gsum yod: seng ge gangs rtsal rdzogs pa bcu: stag mo rang sa zin pa bdun: ma bcos brtul zhugs skyong ba brgyad: gos dkar lcang lo'i sde tshan lnga: khyod dang mnyam pa'i mkha' 'gro bdun: 'brug lo pā shaṃ ming dang ni: tā re ming dang puṇ+ye'i ming: wāk+ka'i ming dang pradz+nyā'i ming: ga ga'i ming dang ār+ya'i ming: de sogs rim bzhin 'phrad nas kyang: zab gter sgo 'phar don gnyis spyod: mkha' spyod bgrod pa nyer lnga dang: 'ja' lus sku brnyes bcu gsum yod: de la sogs pa'i chos bdag ni: brda don gsal ba'i me long bzhin: rig pas dpyod la zab gter spel: smon log bdud sprul shrī'i ming: mchan la khrag gi sme ba yod: de dang 'brel na tshe bsod nyams: dharma'i ming can gzugs byad legs: de dang 'brel na gdul bya nyams: (Dakini secret letter here) nyams pa rnams dang bsre mi rung: bsres na lha srung 'khu ldog byed: mi 'dod sna tshogs rlung ltar 'tshub: nad yams mu ge'i bskal pa dar: tshe chos bsod nams rlung rta nyams: gser dang ra gan 16) ma nor bar: rig pas dpyod la stabs ka gzob: 'gro don rten 'brel kho nar rag: rten 'brel gnad la gzab gal che: mi yi ngo srung chos brgyad kyi: bya ba thams cad rgyab tu bor:

mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung ji bzhin du: dben sar sgrub pa pha mthar son: bskyed rdzogasanyams len gnad la gzhol: mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud zab pa'i chos: rang nyams longs la gces spras kyis: skal med rnams la gsang bar sbos: las ldan bu la rim gyis spel: gter dang gter min dbye ba ni: chang dang chu gnyis nus pa'i khyad: rig pas dpyod dang rim gyis gsal: gter ni yid bzhin nor dang mtshungs: dgos 'dod kun 'byung bsam pa 'grub: tshe 'dir rkyen zhi don gnyis 'grub: phyi ma o rgyan gnas su skye: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral 'khod: gter min sos ka'i me tog bzhin: legs legs 'dra yang phugs mi brtan: gang 'brel tshe bsod dbang thang nyams: phyi ma ngan song gnas su skye: gter 'byin pad+ma'i pho nya ni: dad dang tshul khrims gtong phod che: thos rgya che zhing rang rgyud grol: lta sgom ldan zhing spyod pa zhib: snying rje che zhing nyon mongs 17) chung: 'khor bar zhen log chos brgyad spangs: zhi zhing bag yod chos nyid rtogs: srin pos mthong yang sdig sems zhi: thabs mkhas bstan 'gro'i don smin mdzad: 'di ni 'brel tshad don ldan nas: pad+ma'i pho nya yid bzhin nor: de la rtse gcig gsol ba thobs: gang 'brel pad+ma 'od du 'dren: sa ma ya: gter min zog po bla gzugs ni: thos chung shes rab dman pa dang: nyon mongs rags shing snying rje chung: nyams rtogs mi ldan kha po mtho: rgyu 'bras khyad bsad spyod pa 'chol: sha chang bud med nyams su blang: mdo sngags chos la skur pa 'debs: cha lugs mi 'dra du ma ston: dkor la rgyug cing rlom pa che: chos la kha g.yar mi dge bsag: sa gnas slong dang chos gter 'byin: yul der mi 'dod sna tshogs 'byung: las ngan sems can de la bskyab: gang 'brel thar pa'i dpyangs thag chad: pad+ma nga yi bstan pa ni: nga min nga 'dras bshig par byed: gter rdzun log pas yul khams gang: mi rnams rtsa khams grul bum zhugs:

'jig rten mkha' 'gros lung yang bstan: gsang sngags khrom bsgrag nor la btsong: 18)rtsa rlung gsang khrid khyim par 'chad: de tshe mi 'dod rlung ltar 'tshub: dbyar dgun go ldog drod mi snyoms: sad ser nad yams sna tshogs dar: dmag 'khrug mtshon gyi bskal pa 'byung: de tshe pad 'byung gsol ba thob: ri rgyal rtse la sid+dhi dngaḥ rigs gsum 'dra sku rdo la bris: sa dpal gang yod gter bum sbos: brda don gsal ba'i me long bzhin: rig pas dpyod la stabs ka gzob: rang gter gdams pa zab mo ni: e waṃ ltag sprod ji bzhin du: rten 'brel 'bring gi chos skal dbang: mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin khyod kyis sgrubs: nges med ri la gter sgrub gyis: sgrub pa'i gnas dang rdzas yo byad: mtshan ma rtags sogs gsang rgyas thob: mchog thun dngos grub thob par 'gyur: the tshom med de sa ma ya: chos brgyad ha la'i ku mu ta: dug sbrul nag po'i lce gnyis bdar: (Dakini secret letter here) mu dras bar chad brtsam: khyod yul 'dir mi gnas gzhan du bgrod: de'i rkyen gyis dpa' bo (Dakini secret letter here) nyams: khyod sngon gyi 'phro sad gter la dbang: thabs mi mkhas 'jig rten 'khor bar g.yeng: chos 'dzin gyi skyes bu su 'phrad kyang: re dogs dang 19) le lo'i dbang du song: nged mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin bsgrub ma nus: dbyings ḍā ki'i bka' chad khyod la 'bebs: khyod rang tshugs zin na ngas mi bslu: yul rkyen gyi skyon sun che na'ang: zab chos dang rten 'brel dus su yang: stabs ka gzab pa snying gtam yin: mu tra yi phra mas thabs shes 'dzol: phrin las kyi rdo rje'i rdzong mkhar brten: ma khams gsum dbang sdud las la sbyor: dpal dregs pa rnam gsum phrin las bskul: dus dus su lung bstan snying gtam yin: chos zab pa'i snying po dus su spel: dus ma bab yongs la spel mi rung: rang zab bcud nyams len mi byed na:

grub brnyes kyi dga' ston ci la rol: zab gter gyi khrol bsdam snying gtam yin: khyed dam grib rkyen gyis ma nges dus: nged ḍā kis bsus te dhu ma thal: mkha' 'gro yi gnas su 'u cag mjal: dus re zhig brda thim gu h+ya rgya: he sa ya na snying la sbos: he sa ya na sa ma ya: he sa ya na man+t+ra rgya: zhes zer 'od thig dmar po zhig tu gyur te mi snang bar yal song: yang mkha' 'gro dmar mo sgra sgrog yin zer ba mdun gral nas bdag gi 20)sar byon nas sku'i gar bsgyur te 'di skad gsungs: he he: gnas 'di ni 'og min dhu ma thal: ma mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas: khyod ma brjed tsit+ta'i ga'ur sbos: bstan 'gro ba'i don du yi ger 'khod: gang 'brel tshad gnas 'dir 'khod par nges: shar phyogs nas chos bdag rdo rje'i ming: bar chad kyi dam sṛ sdang bcas 'ong: dpal rta mgrin brtul zhugs de la gtod: rnga yul la ngag dbang rgya mtsho zhes: khong sbas pa'i rnal 'byor he ru ka: der 'phrad na rdzogs chen chos sgo 'byed: 'on kyang khyod kyi nyams rtogs dang: gdul bya longs spyod tshe dpal rnams: thabs grogs dag la rag las pas: rten 'brel gtso che stabs ka gzob: snyan grags sa gsum khyab nas kyang: bu slob stong phrag thar lam 'god: don gnyis 'grub cing tshe tshad ni: drug cu lnga bar bsrings nges shing: dam tshig nyams pa'i grib kyis ni: 'phral 'phral tshe la bar chad mang: o rgyan chen po'i gsung ji bzhin: dgra dam grib min pas gos ma myong: gsungs ji bzhin dam grib rkyen la 'dzems: khyod rang blo gzhan la ma gtod par: rang thag 21) rang gis gcod pa gces: lho dam sri'i sprul pa'i mi mo yis: rdzas ha la'i sbyor ba khyod la brtsam: de rig pas dpyod la stabs ka gzob: (Dakini secret letter here) de las bshad pa mang du med: 'u cag bde stong dbyings su mjal: dus dang dus su lung bstan nas:

bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub par nges: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gyis: dam nyams lag tu ma shor bar: thub par srungs shig sa ma ya: log lta can gyi dbang po snubs: rtog ge mkhan gyi snying khrag longs: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: sku rgya: gsung rgya: thugs rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: zhes zer nas zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas yang byang gi brda don rnams ma brjed par yid la zungs dang nged rnams kyis grogs dan byed gsungs nas mched lcam thams cad tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rgyan du rol nas rang gnas la bzhugs: bdag 'jig rten gyi khams su skyel ma mdzad nas thams cad chos nyid 'od gsal gyi klong du dbyings la thim mo: sa ma ya: zhes pa
